claims.claim: Sigmoid markets a forward-deployed engineering model in which FDEs are paired with prebuilt production agents and data-engineering accelerators, with one engineer orchestrating many agents.
claims.quote: Sigmoid pairs Forward Deployed Engineers with a pre-built arsenal of production agents, data-engineering accelerators and frameworks, on a foundation we have been building since before "agentic" was a word. One engineer, orchestrating many agents, delivering the end-to-end enterprise product that used to take a room full of specialists.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Sigmoid says other firms are only now discovering the FDE model, while it has used it for a decade.
claims.quote: Others are discovering the FDE model now. For Sigmoid it is simply how we have built for a decade, and our FDEs never arrive empty-handed.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Sigmoid positions its FDE offering between linear services and pure product, retaining consulting depth and customization while using a digital workforce for leverage.
claims.quote: This is not a volume play. It sits between the linear services model and pure product, keeping the consulting depth and customization enterprises need while adding the leverage of a digital workforce, so a focused FDE team ships what once took a small army.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Sigmoid claims one FDE can span an entire enterprise build that previously needed six or seven specialist skill sets and separate pods.
claims.quote: An end-to-end enterprise product, the workflows, the pipelines, the models and the app, once needed six or seven specialist skill sets and a pod for each. Sigmoid codifies what each team does into a production agent, so a single Forward Deployed Engineer can span the whole build.
